title: Send feedback
messagePlaceholder: Start with a short title. What did you do, what did you expect and what happened?
imageLimit: Up to 3 images, 1 MB in total. PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP. You can also paste images into the description.
successMessage: Your feedback has been submitted successfully.
errorGeneric: Submission could not be confirmed. Your draft has been kept. Check your connection and try again later.
messageHelp: At least 10 characters. The first line becomes the issue title.
publicNotice: Your message and images will be public on GitHub for Pile Plan Studio. You do not need a GitHub account. Do not share confidential information.
contactHint: Your name and email address are only shared with the team and are not included in the public issue. Email is only needed if you would like a reply.
environment: App version {{appVersion}} and operating system {{osInfo}} will be included.
issueCreated: Your feedback has been sent and a public GitHub issue has been created.
storedMessage: Open Feedback Studio has received your message. No public issue has been created yet; the team can view your submission.
errorImagesCount: You can attach up to 3 images.
errorImagesSize: Images must be no larger than 1 MB in total. Remove an image or choose a smaller file.
errorImageType: Choose a PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP image.
errorInvalidEmail: Enter a valid email address or leave the field empty.
errorName: Your name must be no longer than 200 characters.
errorRateLimit: You have sent several messages in a short time. Please try again later. Your draft has been kept.
errorDuplicate: This message has already been received. You do not need to submit it again.
errorRejected: Your submission was not accepted. Check your text and images and try again.
errorScreenshot: The screenshot could not be captured. You can add or paste an image yourself.
errorOpenIssue: Your feedback was sent, but the issue link could not be opened. Try opening the link again.
